fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Live External Integration run 32568560934 (bedrock arm) fails
`tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:183`
`test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials` 0/3 trials, deterministically
(temperature 0, 3/3 identical), every trial `{"banked": 5, "verdict": "PASS", "error": None,
"calls_at_bank": [11,11,11,11,11], "evidence_calls": 11}`. Root cause is PROVEN (see RCA comment):
commit `e1352535ace` (ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86, Gerrit-reviewed, deliberate) changed
`src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py` so additional batched EVIDENCE calls in an
evidence-claimed model response execute instead of being suppressed with a steering notice. That
was correct (the suppression banked provably false `met=false` verdicts), but it decoupled the two
units this test's oracle silently equated: the enforcement boundary is denominated in evidence
RESPONSES (`current_evidence_steps` is a set of run_steps, `max_evidence_responses=3` at
`src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py:111`), while the oracle `_bounded_bank_gaps`
(`tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:118`) bounds gaps in EXECUTED
filesystem-tool calls (counter at `tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:65`).
A batching model executes ~11 reads in <=2 evidence responses, so the executed-call bound is
structurally unsatisfiable post-dd41 (stub replay E1b showed even a fired 3-response fallback
lands at executed counter 9). The production behavior is intended; the TEST is the defective
artifact (a stale, over-specified oracle unit). The banking contract itself is unchanged: at most
3 evidence responses per current criterion before a fail-closed bank.

## Approach

Test-only repair: re-denominate the live oracle's measurement and bound to the unit the
enforcement is denominated in — evidence responses — instead of the pre-dd41 incidental unit of
executed calls. This preserves the 0707 safety intent (incremental banking with bounded gaps, no
zero-bank exhaustion: a trial with zero banks or with a first bank after >3 evidence responses
still FAILS) while accepting the dd41-intended batched execution. No production code changes;
reverting dd41 instead would reinstate its proven false-verdict defect, so it is not an option.

Measurement seam (confirmed by reading the tree): `src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:312` imports
`wrap_completion_evidence_policy` function-locally at call time from
`rebar.llm.completion_tool_policy`, so a monkeypatch on that module attribute is picked up per
run. The trial harness will patch it with a wrapper that calls the original and then wraps the
returned toolsets in an outer counting toolset which records the distinct `ctx.run_step` values
at which a governed evidence tool (`read_file`/`list_directory`/`search_files`) actually executed
(a result equal to `COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE`/`ALL_CRITERIA_BANKED_NOTICE`,
`src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py:46`/`:51`, means steered-not-executed and is not
counted). The existing `make_observed_upsert` observer (`tests/_bank_observer.py`) then snapshots
the evidence-RESPONSE count at each criterion's first tool write; `_bounded_bank_gaps` keeps its
exact shape (points, pairwise gaps, all gaps <= 3) over response-denominated points, matching
`max_evidence_responses=3`. The raw executed-call counter stays in the trial dict as a
diagnostic only. The shared counting toolset and the gap oracle move into `tests/_bank_observer.py`
so the live eval and a new live-independent unit regression exercise one implementation (the
factoring pattern that module's docstring already prescribes).

## Scope

- `tests/_bank_observer.py` — add the response-counting wrapper-toolset factory and the
  response-denominated bounded-gap oracle helper alongside `make_observed_upsert`.
- `tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py` — patch
  `completion_tool_policy.wrap_completion_evidence_policy` in `_observe_trial` to install the
  counting toolset; record `responses_at_bank` (response units) for the oracle; keep
  `evidence_calls` as diagnostic; update `_bounded_bank_gaps` to consume the response-denominated
  points; update the module docstring to name the post-dd41 unit.
- `tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py` (new) — live-independent regression driving the
  shared helpers over stub transcripts through the REAL `wrap_completion_evidence_policy`:
  (1) intended post-dd41 shape (two batched evidence responses then five records) is ACCEPTED;
  (2) the original 0707 defect shapes are REJECTED — zero banks at exhaustion, and a first bank
  only after >3 evidence responses; (3) steered calls are not counted as responses.

## Testing

Happy path: the unit regression's accepted-shape case (batched execution, all criteria banked,
gaps <= 3 responses) passes against the real policy wrapper. Failure/edge paths: the unit
regression's rejected shapes (zero-bank exhaustion; unbounded first bank at >3 evidence
responses; steering notices not counted) all FAIL the oracle — this is the RED-preserving teeth
check required by the strict test-modification order, run with no production change present. The
live eval itself is bedrock-pinned and cannot run locally; final GREEN is confirmed by a
post-merge `workflow_dispatch` of external-integration.yml (the same trigger as the failing run).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `_bounded_bank_gaps` and the trial measurement are denominated in evidence responses
  (distinct executed-evidence run_steps), verified by reading the revised test and by the unit
  regression passing via `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py -q`.
- [x] The revised oracle still REJECTS the original 0707 defect shapes (zero banks; first bank
  after more than 3 evidence responses), asserted by dedicated unit cases run with no production
  code modified.
- [x] The revised oracle ACCEPTS the dd41-intended batched shape that currently fails
  ([11,11,11,11,11] executed-call signature collapsing to <=3 evidence responses), asserted by a
  unit case replaying that exact transcript.
- [x] No files outside the three declared test paths change (`git diff --stat` on the change
  shows only those paths).
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`
  pass in the worktree venv.
- [x] [non-codebase] After merge, a dispatched Live External Integration run shows
  `test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials` PASSED on the bedrock arm.
